title: Multiple purposes
text: Multiple purposes. I bought two of these. I set up one with my youngest daughters help. The first one I used to organize my cookie sheets and flat pans. The second one I used for my Pyrex covers. These are a great organization tool, and they make it much easier to see what I’m trying to get without rummaging through a bunch of pans or covers.
